cards.title: Today’s vocabulary
sections: seat belt · /sit bɛlt/ · noun · Phrase · New
A belt that holds a person in a vehicle seat. There is a seat belt on this bus seat.
A passage between rows of seats. Please keep your bag out of the aisle.
window seat · /ˈwɪndoʊ ˌsit/ · noun phrase · Phrase · New
a seat next to a window in a vehicle or building. I would like a window seat, please.
A line of seats or other things placed side by side. Our seats are in the first row.
a person traveling in a vehicle without driving it. Each passenger needs a ticket.
Cover the words. Say three from memory. Make a new sentence with one, then check the example.
